TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd (est. 2012) is a SECP-incorporated Pakistani technology and engineering company with ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certifications and a CMMI Level 3 appraisal, delivering complex implementations for Federal and Provincial Government, private-sector, and international clients. [CO-PROFILE] We are FBR-registered with Active Taxpayer List (ATL) status and can arrange bid security in the form of a CDR/bank guarantee from scheduled banks up to our facility limit. [CO-PROFILE]

For the Provincial Health Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s tender to supply, implement, integrate, and support an integrated HMIS across four tertiary-care hospitals, we bring directly relevant hospital IT delivery experience and the delivery capacity to execute a multi-site, multi-module rollout with training and three years of support. Our recent health-sector implementations include hospital IT deployments completed in 2023 (Provincial Government) and 2022 (International), demonstrating sustained delivery in the last five years. [CAP-018][CAP-030]

Our strongest proof points include:
- Proven hospital IT deployments (including public-sector health environments). [CAP-018][CAP-042]
- ISO 27001-aligned delivery and operations experience across large implementations. [CO-PROFILE][CAP-012]
- PMP-certified project managers (6) to govern scope, schedule, risk, and change across four sites. [CO-PROFILE]

Where the RFP is highly specific, we will be transparent: our evidence library does not yet document prior HL7 v2.x/FHIR R4 interfaces, the requested 99.5% monthly availability with a 4-hour RTO, nor a CMMI Level 5 appraisal. [CO-PROFILE] We will address these through named specialist subcontracting and a contractually committed SLA/DR design validated during solution architecture (Q3) and implementation planning (Q4).

We commit to a disciplined, phased rollout with structured training for ~1,200 users, robust data protection controls under ISO 27001, and a responsive support model aligned to the Department’s three-year O&M expectations. [CO-PROFILE]
